class.name: InteractionTrigger
class.brief_description: [color=red](Not user creatable)[/color] Interaction triggers are used to define areas where players can interact. Use by instantiating the (res://Engine/Overworld/Interactions/interaction_trigger.tscn) scene.
class.description:
This scene is used to define areas where players can interact in the overworld. Instead of creating nodes directly, you must use it by instantiating the (res://Engine/Overworld/Interactions/interaction_trigger.tscn) scene.
You can adjust the size of the interaction area using the [member Node2D.scale] property. When the player presses [code]ui_accept[/code] input while inside the interaction area,
the [signal interacted] signal is emitted.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: enable
method.description: Enables the interaction trigger, allowing it to detect player interactions.

method.name: disable
method.description: Disables the interaction trigger, preventing it from detecting player interactions.

signal.name: interacted
signal.description: Emitted when the player interacts within the interaction area by pressing the [code]ui_accept[/code] input.
